note: 109-acre KDWP state fishing lake in the Flint Hills west of Cottonwood Falls; free primitive camping, first come first served, on about a dozen gravel spurs along the north shore, eight or nine of which suit an RV (camper report, April 2026). Vault toilets, no hookups. --Claude
